composition.serve_who: This sheet ("24V DC SERVICE SUPPLY", GMMS 108'-110a) is a power one-line showing PORT/STBD 600V DC HVPDU buses stepped down via MAPS-1/2 converters to 24V DC, distributed through an isolator/contactor bank (SW1-5/SO1-5) and a +24V Service Bus (fused F5-F9) to named loads: FWD DC PANEL, AFT DC PANEL, BILGE PUMP, FIRE PUMP, GEN START BAT., AUX SERVICE BAT., plus a 230VAC-to-24VDC 110A supply feeding BAE start-key/service-mode logic (Re1/Re2 relays) tied to ONYX monitoring and a PC CARD controller (BEL-1/4 230V AC control, see DWG 401a/114). The named load rows attach to their respective equipment nodes per the engineer-confirmed mapping; the HVPDU/MAPS/bus/breaker/terminal-strip/relay structure itself is shared distribution infrastructure serving the vessel's 24V DC service system as a whole (attached to 640-dc-distribution).

facts: PORT and STBD HVPDU each provide a 600V DC bus, protected by breakers Q1-Q4 (32A each) and main fuses F1/F2 500A (Aux/Bat.), feeding PORT and STBD MAPS-1/2 2x5kW converters (600V DC/24V DC, electronically fused, over-current protected per CTB1-7 = QI-POWER-485-300-LV legend, CTB7 dedicated to Emergency Bat.)

MAPS-1/2 24V DC outputs are individually fused F1-F4 250A and monitored by CT1-CT4 (each behind a 70A breaker) before reaching an isolator/contactor bank of SW1-5 switches paired with SO1-5 solenoid contactors
Isolator bank outputs consolidate onto the +24V Service Bus via SHUNT #1 (500A/50mV) for current measurement
+24V Service Bus is fused out to five branches: F5 100A (SW6, FWD DC PANEL), F6 200A (SW7, AFT DC PANEL), F7 60A (SW8, BILGE PUMP), F8 60A (SW9, FIRE PUMP), F9 125A (SW10, see DWG 110b)
Separate AUX SERVICE BAT. (200Ah 24V) branch via SW11 and F16 250A fuse, with SO9 switch tapping toward GEN. START BAT.
Separate 230VAC-fed 24V/110A power supply (F18 125A) feeds BAE start-key/service-mode terminal strip (T/S S) and relay bank (Re1/Re2), cross-referenced to DWG 113 and DWG 413
Negative bus / 230V AC ground bar (=SHIPS GROUND) ties together return/reference drops for FWD DC PANEL, AFT DC PANEL, BILGE PUMP, FIRE PUMP, GEN START BAT., EMERGENCY BAT., AUX SERVICE BAT.
T/S E terminal strip with QE7 6A breaker routes to +24V EMERGENCY POWER
PC CARD enclosure (bottom-left) provides BAE/AUX/NEG/+EM selector logic feeding BEL-1/4 230V AC CONTROL output (see DWG 401a) and links to ON/OFF SW (see DWG 114)

uncertainties: Exact rating/fuse values for the SO9 branch toward GEN. START BAT. are not printed on the sheet.

Fine terminal numbering inside the T/S S groups (1-7 and 5-12) is small and partly ambiguous per prior extraction; exact relay coil/contact assignments (Re1 vs Re2 to which terminal) not fully legible.
CT5 and CT6 monitored circuit identities (which specific feeder each CT clamps) are not explicitly labeled beyond their position near the BAE start-key logic and LV BAE Panel run respectively.

The PC CARD's BEL-1/4 230V AC CONTROL output is mapped here to 629-bel1-p as the closest matching engineer vocabulary entry, but the sheet does not distinguish BEL-1 vs BEL-2 vs BEL-4 exactly — could plausibly also relate to 629-bel2-p or a combined BEL node; flagged as uncertain attachment.
Small print in the PORT/STBD MAPS-1/2 wiring boxes (partially illegible fuse IDs per prior extraction) limits full DRY DATA precision for the MAPS converter internal wiring.
